messages:
aisha-cs: Ok team — Vanguard go-live this Friday. Need final quota + autoscale plan. Who's free for a 30m sync?

tom-eng: I can run the load tests tonight. Propose a stepped ramp: 10rps -> 100rps -> 500rps over 30m, with a 1h soak at peak. Will capture token/sec so we can map to billing.

priya-ml: Quantization plan is set. Two questions: do we pin to the float16 variant for latency, or use int8 quant for cost? Also need to confirm dedicated pool size: 4xA100 (better p95) vs 6xA10 (cheaper).

jared-ops: For SLOs I'm leaning 4xA100. Proposed autoscaler: min_replicas=3, max_replicas=8, scale_target=0.65 (GPU utilization). I can push the scaler config — snippet below.

jared-ops: ```yaml
# autoscaler for vanguard pool
policy:gpu_utilization
min_replicas: 3
max_replicas: 8
target_util: 0.65
cooldown_seconds: 120
priority: reserved
```

aisha-cs: Please also post the load script + expected token rates so I can update the onboarding doc and send to the customer. They'll want the burn-rate estimate.

tom-eng: Load script will be a replay with preserved inter-arrival times via our replay tool. Quick k6 snippet for smoke: ```js
import http from 'k6/http';
export default function() {
  http.post('https://api.redwood.test/generate', JSON.stringify({prompt: 'ping'}));
}
```
Expected avg tokens/sec at 500rps ~ 45k tokens/s (peak). Will drop the replay bundle into the runbook link: https://redwood.example/runbooks/vanguard-onboard (private). :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Load test scheduled: 2025-09-18T02:00:00Z by tom-eng. Notifications: #customer-success, #eng-runtime.

priya-ml: One request from customer: enable short-circuit fallback to a smaller model for >1.5s tail latencies. Can we test the fallback path during soak (simulate degraded nodes)?

aisha-cs: Good call. Let's add a canary route at 5% traffic with automatic fallback to the 8-bit variant. Meeting 16:00 today to finalize. @tom-eng @jared-ops @priya-ml :thumbsup:

jared-ops: I'll post the exact scaler and fallback policy after the sync.

aisha-cs: Thanks — I'll update the account health doc and flag renewal risk low if we hit SLOs.
